* test: expect resolved model path in adapter forwarding fixture

* docs: refresh Spanish, training and capture validation guidance

* docs: distinguish experiment support from validated hardware

* fix: retain English startup fallback after pinned download failure

* docs: bind live model inventory to reviewed startup fallback

* docs: audit completed per-language TTS routing acceptance

* docs: reconcile routing acceptance and current source validation

* fix: preserve capture loss accounting through shutdown

* test: use explicit stream contracts for capture fixtures

* docs: retain completed EN-ES and Lite experiment rejections

* fix: preserve captions when preview translation is empty

* fix: allow bounded larger endurance diagnostics

* docs: reconcile completed Mac screens and retained service failures

* docs: retain verified Mac delivery and refresh remaining roadmap
